song.title: The Downside Of Heaven Is The Upside Of Hell

guitar.evidence: Lostalone (UK rock band fronted by Steven Battelle) has no widely documented signature guitar gear.

tone.target: dark saturated fuzz-crunch with big modulated delay wash
tone.profile: dark saturated fuzz-crunch with big modulated delay wash
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Boost/OD -> High-Gain Amp (Recti) -> Cab -> EQ -> Chorus -> Delay -> Reverb. This chain emphasizes saturation and deep modulation.

rig.name: Lostalone - The Downside Of Heaven Is The Upside Of Hell - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Slight boost to push the fuzz into the amp harder.
blocks.gap: The Boost is used here as a general tone shaper/pre-gain stage, mimicking an overdrive pedal's initial grit without defining its character.

blocks.purpose: Core heavy fuzz tone as requested.

blocks.gap: The Recti model is ideal for modern, saturated hard rock/metal tones required by the 'dark grit' description.

blocks.purpose: To ground the massive fuzz tone with a robust cabinet sound.
blocks.gap: Mess 4x12 provides a versatile, powerful platform suitable for high-gain tones.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the low end and high-mids to maintain definition under heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: Used to counter potential muddiness from the extreme fuzz/high gain stack, avoiding a thin scoop.

blocks.purpose: Adding a subtle modulation wash to complement the delay and reverb.
blocks.gap: While chorus was cautioned against, a moderate setting is used here to provide 'big modulated' texture without sounding like 80s pop.

blocks.purpose: Creating the required long modulated delay wash.
Providing the required big reverb wash and sense of space.
blocks.gap: Plate is chosen over Room for a more defined, yet massive, decay tail suitable for dark rock.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better dark, saturated cabinet realism.

proposals.reason: Enhance the deep, dark grit and saturation of the fuzz tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased depth and darkness in the low-mids.
